review_scope: selected four PNGs directly opened using view_image
pose identity and visible limb continuity
approved character role and costume consistency
actual read-only RGBA source-over composite on charcoal #15171E

method.raw: Built-in view_image read all four raw PNGs.
method.composite: Read selected PNG buffers, decode RGBA and alpha filters in memory, composite source-over on RGB(21,23,30), and emit review PNGs for direct visual inspection.
